name: Shovel-billed Kookaburra
rangeDescription: New guinea (primarily in hills and adjacent lowlands)
description: A huge, rare kingfisher of rainforest interior from lowlands to mid-mountains. Its unnaturally large bill makes it look almost unrecognisable as a kingfisher.

name: Crimson-headed Partridge
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern borneo
description: Unmistakable black partridge with a bright red head (hence the alternative name, “Bloodhead”). Inhabits Bornean montane forest (roughly 1000–1700 m) but may be encountered outside this altitudinal range.

name: Sao Tome Weaver
rangeDescription: Highlands of são tomé (gulf of guinea)
description: A medium-sized weaver with white wingbars, endemic to São Tomé. Sexes look quite different: the male has olive-brown upperparts and a burnt-orange face and upper breast, while the female is more washed-out dull brown above and buff-white below.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Swallow-tailed Manakin
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southeastern brazil (southern bahia) to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: A very common inhabitant of humid forests. Small chunky manakin with elongated central tail feathers.

name: Green Pygmy-Goose
rangeDescription: Eastern lesser sundas, southern moluccas, southern new guinea, and northeastern western australia to southeastern queensland (northern and eastern australia)
description: Tiny duck. Male has dark green head and neck with a white cheek-flash.

name: Ross's Turaco
rangeDescription: Riparian forest and woodland of central africa
description: Spectacular purple turaco with a yellow bill and face and a puffy red crest. Shows large crimson wing patches in flight.

name: Kilombero Weaver
rangeDescription: Southeastern tanzania (floodplain of kilombero river)
description: A fairly small and slim weaver with a relatively slender bill. Breeding male is distinctive, with bright yellow overall plumage and a black-and-chestnut bib.

name: Steller's Sea-Eagle
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern siberia; winters to china, korea, and japan including ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: An immense eagle with large head and massive orange bill to match. Adult is striking, even from a great distance: rich brown overall, with snow-white tail, belly, and shoulder patches.

name: Blue-headed Macaw
rangeDescription: Eastern peru to northern bolivia and far western brazil
description: Small macaw of lowland rainforest. Its dull blue head is distinctive; the species is otherwise green with blue wings.

name: Cedar Waxwing
rangeDescription: North america; winters to northern south america and greater antilles
description: Plump, smooth-plumaged bird with distinctive thin, high-pitched call. Adults have a sleek crest, black mask, pale yellow wash on the belly, and yellow-tipped tail.

name: Iberian Green Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Iberian peninsula and the pyrénées
description: Fairly large woodpecker with a green back, red crown, and broad whisker stripe (red in males, black in females). Yellowish rump shows mainly in slightly undulating flight.

name: Sao Francisco Sparrow
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (interior of minas gerais and bahia)
description: Handsome, poorly-known sparrow with a bright olive back and a black-and-white face pattern. Note the yellow bill with a black upper ridge.

name: Banded Ground-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Impressively large, roadrunner-like bird of wet foothill rainforest. It’s one of the rarest and most sought-after birds of northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia.

name: Bannerman's Sunbird
rangeDescription: Northern angola to southeastern democratic republic of the congo and far northwestern zambia
description: A medium-sized sunbird with an olive back and gray belly. Male has a metallic bluish (may appear green in some light) hood and breast; female appears plain-headed with limited metallic plumage on crown.

name: Sierra Madre Crow
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (sierra madre mountains of luzon)
description: Uncommon small black crow. Plumage has an iridescent dark blue sheen when seen up close.

name: Western Olivaceous Warbler
rangeDescription: Iberian peninsula, morocco, tunisia, algeria, and libya
description: Large buff-colored warbler with a heavy flat bill and long tail. Olive-gray upperparts contrast with the pale bill.

name: St. Helena Plover
rangeDescription: St. helena island (southern atlantic ocean)
description: A long-legged plover with a long black bill, a black eye mask and crown, and a white forehead. Upperparts brownish, and underparts whitish washed with peachy orange.

name: Solomons Nightjar
rangeDescription: Northern and central solomon islands
description: A large-eyed and immaculately camouflaged nocturnal bird. Plumage is a mixture of brown, rufous, and gray speckling and barring, with a small white throat patch and a faint rufous collar.

name: Gray-bellied Comet
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern peru (southern cajamarca to western huánuco)
description: Large hummingbird with a long, forked tail found only in the Andes of northwestern Peru. Rare and known from very few sites.

name: Rapa Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Rapa island (austral archipelago); seriously endangered
description: A colorful fruit-dove with a bluish gray neck and head, a mostly vibrant green body and wings, and pink patches on the belly and forehead. No other similar species share its range.
